indexes.comment: Day ledger paging. The day is now the partition (dayHeads/{dateKey}/transactions), so this serves one subcollection: newest sale first, with the document id as a stable tiebreak for the cursor. A single-field orderBy would be served by the automatic index, so this one is belt and braces — it pins the cursor order so it can never depend on an implicit tiebreak, and it stays a declared contract if a second ordering is ever added.

Developer console 'All recent' view, which spans every day. A collection-group query reaches all dayHeads/*/transactions subcollections at once, so the old dateKey-first composite index is gone: the day is no longer a field being filtered on.
